name: oclive-vscode
description: Chat with OCLive role packs from VS Code (kernel_server --api)

commands.title: OCLive: Sync Diary Summary to Memory

oclive.autoDiscover.description: Auto-find rolesDir and kernel binary (workspace, sibling oclivenewnew, shared runtime, extension bin/).

oclive.promoteSharedKernel.description: When a full dev/desktop kernel is found, copy it to %LOCALAPPDATA%/OCLive/runtime for other distributions.

oclive.rolesDir.description: Path to roles root (OCLIVE_ROLES_DIR). Empty = auto-discover on first use.

oclive.roleId.description: Default role pack id under rolesDir.

oclive.roleAllowlist.description: When non-empty, only these role pack ids appear in role pickers.

oclive.chat.portraitPaneHeight.description: Chat portrait pane height in px. Drag the splitter in Chat or adjust in Settings → Layout.

oclive.chat.inputMinHeight.description: Chat input textarea minimum height in px.

oclive.chat.streaming.description: Use POST /chat/stream for token-by-token rendering; false falls back to /chat.

oclive.chat.warmupModel.description: Pre-warm local Ollama model after bootstrap or role switch (provider=local only).

oclive.chat.warmupKeepAlive.description: Ollama keep_alive passed to warmup generate (e.g. 10m, 30m).

oclive.settings.placement.description: Where to open settings: embedded in chat sidebar or beside editor.

oclive.kernelBinary.description: Override kernel spawn path. Empty = auto (shared runtime > dev build > extension bin/).

oclive.includeEditorContext.description: Prepend active editor file/selection to outgoing messages.

oclive.mockLlm.description: Set OCLIVE_HTTP_API_MOCK_LLM=1 when spawning kernel (dev only).

oclive.penetration.diaryPath.description: Diary path template relative to workspace root; {roleId} is substituted.

oclive.penetration.autoDiaryEveryNTurns.description: Auto-append diary every N chat turns; 0 disables.

oclive.penetration.allowedGlobs.description: Whitelist globs for penetration write paths.

oclive.penetration.previewAfterWrite.description: Open diary file in editor after append.

oclive.penetration.terminal.enabled.description: Show a read-only one-liner in the integrated terminal after diary append.

oclive.penetration.idle.enabled.description: When window loses focus, remind to open chat after idle seconds.

oclive.penetration.idle.dailyLimit.description: Max idle reminders per day; 0 = unlimited.

oclive.penetration.memorySync.enabled.description: Allow manual sync of today's diary summary into long_term_memory (C2).

oclive.penetration.memorySync.importance.description: Importance passed to update_memory when syncing diary.

scripts.build:webview: cd webview-ui && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.compile:all: npm run build:webview && npm run compile
